chunks: Except those on whom your Lord had mercy, for which He created them. And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled: 'I will fill Hell with jinns and men, all together.'
ai.seo_question: Who will fill Hell according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Hud underscores the completeness of Allah's decree by contrasting the general creation of beings with the specific exception of those granted divine mercy. In Shia exegesis, this distinction highlights the interplay between divine justice and mercy, affirming that the filling of Hell with jinns and humans is the fulfillment of a predetermined word, while mercy remains a distinct, selective grace.
